explanation = TextContent("To assess if you can afford to hire someone, you'd typically look at financial metrics like revenue, profit margins, and budget. This information can indicate if existing staff are at capacity or if there's a growing need for more support.", "default")

dashboardMetrics = Query("host_getDashboard", {}, {"clientsMissingDocs":0,"documentsOutstanding":0,"documentsReceived":0,"documentsTotal":0,"clientsTotal":0,"nearestDeadline":"","nearestDeadlineClient":{"id":"","businessName":"","filingDeadline":""}})
allClients = Query("host_listClients", {}, [])

kpis = Stack([totalClientsCard, missingDocsCard, outstandingDocsCard, nearestDeadlineCard], "row", "m", "stretch", "start", true)

totalClientsCard = Card([
    TextContent("Total Clients", "small"),
    TextContent("" + dashboardMetrics.clientsTotal, "large-heavy")
], "card", "column", "s")

missingDocsCard = Card([
    TextContent("Clients Missing Documents", "small"),
    TextContent("" + dashboardMetrics.clientsMissingDocs, "large-heavy")
], "card", "column", "s")

outstandingDocsCard = Card([
    TextContent("Documents Outstanding", "small"),
    TextContent("" + dashboardMetrics.documentsOutstanding, "large-heavy")
], "card", "column", "s")

nearestDeadlineCard = Card([
    TextContent("Nearest Deadline", "small"),
    TextContent(dashboardMetrics.nearestDeadline == "" ? "N/A" : dashboardMetrics.nearestDeadline + " (" + dashboardMetrics.nearestDeadlineClient.businessName + ")", "large-heavy")
], "card", "column", "s")

clientListSection = Card([
    CardHeader("Client Overview", "Review client workload and assignments"),
    clientTable
], "card")

clientTable = Table([
    Col("Business Name", allClients.businessName),
    Col("Contact", allClients.contactName),
    Col("Assignee", @Each(allClients, "client", client.assignee.name + " (" + client.assignee.initials + ")")),
    Col("Filing Deadline", allClients.filingDeadline),
    Col("Progress", @Each(allClients, "client", client.progress.received + "/" + client.progress.total)),
    Col("Status", @Each(allClients, "client", Tag(client.status, null, "sm", client.status == "On Track" ? "success" : client.status == "At Risk" ? "warning" : "danger")))
])
